scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street view of a pedestrian crossing the intersection of two streets in a downtown area. The person is wearing a blue jacket and black pants and has a purple bag in her hand. There are several buildings surrounding the intersection including a brown building with balconies and a beige building with a storefront. There are also several scooters parked along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.buildings: The brown building has three floors with balconies and a storefront on the ground floor. The beige building has a storefront and a balcony on the second floor. Both buildings have a mix of windows and doors.
scene_analysis.materials: The brown building has a concrete facade with a smooth texture. The beige building has a wooden facade with a rough texture.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several tables and chairs outside the cafe on the left side of the street. A white umbrella provides shade for customers.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are no visible plants or trees in the immediate vicinity of the intersection.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted on the street, including a yellow sign with a red circle and a blue sign with white text.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The street is quiet, with only a few pedestrians visible.
scene_analysis.as_commuter: The street is wide enough for cars to drive through, but there are no vehicles visible.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The street is lined with shops and cafes, and there are several people visible in the distance.
scene_analysis.as_student: The street is relatively empty, with only a few people visible.
